newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCC approves Australis recap deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCC approves Australis recap deal.

text.p: Australis Media Ltd said on Friday that the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) had approved the company's recapitalisation plan.
Australis also said the ACCC had also approved the DTH satellite joint venture with cable television operator Optus Vision for the sharing of DTH satellite infrastructure.
It said it had also secured additional equity commitments, which will result in an injection of US$100 million of cash into the company.

The company will shortly conduct a roadshow in the United States for the US$150 million new note issue. The new equity raising and note issue will close prior to October 31, 1996, when the interim bank facility of US$125 million matures.
